title: 第一卷 第3章 丹田蜕变实力大涨第一卷 第4章 血海浮屠魂断三生
content_zh:
秦永的身体，蜷缩在地上。
痛苦的呻吟。
“秦逸，外边有我的贴身护卫李刚……”
“你……你现在收手，还来得及……如若不然，你一定会落得个求生不得，求死不能的下场！”
秦永还想威胁秦逸。
“你们一家，将我当成修炼的资源，我的混沌九玄体神异已尽，要不是最近还需要用我的精血给你安抚灵泉丹田，你们早就将我毁尸灭迹了。”
“我不杀你，你们就会放过我？”
“你以为我会相信这种可笑的话？”
“我今天就告诉你，我不仅会杀了你，我还要从这里杀出去，你们一家人的报应，这才刚刚开始！”
秦逸脚下发力。
秦永的一根根肋骨断去，刺入脏腑中。
秦永大口大口地吐血。
这时，秦逸的脑海中，小鼎轻轻震荡，发出声音：“小家伙，开始吧。”
“就连鼎爷我也有点好奇，你收回的第一颗魔种以及灵泉丹田，将会出现怎样的蜕变？”
“嗯！”秦逸回应了一声。
他深吸了一口气，压下激荡的情绪，他的身体半蹲，五指如爪，猛然落在了秦永的腹部位置。
灵泉丹田，便被秦逸硬生生从秦永的腹部，一点一点扯了出来。
整个过程，秦永都在发出撕心裂肺的惨叫！
当灵泉丹田彻底被秦逸抓出来后。
秦永的身体，直接化作了灰烬。

他的气血，灵魂，全都被灵泉丹田内暗藏的魔种，一并带了出来。
秦逸手中，灵光璀璨，精纯的元气喷涌。
灵泉丹田，顾名思义，丹田内元气犹如泉眼喷涌，拥有这种丹田的武者，修行进境极快。
下一刻，秦逸将手中这暗藏魔种的灵泉丹田，按向了自己的腹部。
灵泉丹田回归！
丹田内的魔种，化作一股神异的力量，刹那间扩散！
“轰！”
秦逸的灵泉丹田内，好似发出了开天辟地般的大响。
丹田在快速扩大。
而且，泛起点点金光。
只是几个呼吸的时间而已，秦逸的丹田，就已宛若元力的海洋，煊赫金光透着辉煌浩荡之意！
秦逸收回灵泉丹田与魔种，产生了蜕变，丹田如海般浩瀚，金光狂涌。
content_en:
Qin Yong's body curled up on the ground.
Groan of pain.
"Qin Yi, there is my personal bodyguard Li Gang outside..."
"You...you have time to stop now...if not, you will definitely end up unable to survive or die!"
Qin Yong also wanted to threaten Qin Yi.
"Your family regards me as a resource for cultivation. My Nine Mystical Chaos Physics has exhausted all its magical powers. If it weren't for the recent need to use my blood and essence to appease your Lingquan Dantian, you would have destroyed my body and wiped out all traces of me."
"If I don't kill you, will you let me go?"
"You think I would believe such ridiculous words?"
"I will tell you today, I will not only kill you, I will also fight out of here. The retribution for your family has just begun!"
Qin Yi exerted force with his feet.
Qin Yong's ribs were broken one by one and pierced into his organs.
Qin Yong vomited blood.
At this time, in Qin Yi's mind, the small tripod vibrated slightly and made a voice: "Little guy, let's start."
"Even Mr. Ding, I'm a little curious, what kind of transformation will happen to the first demon seed and Lingquan Dantian you took back?"
"Yeah!" Qin Yi responded.
He took a deep breath and suppressed his turbulent emotions. His body squatted down, and his fingers, like claws, suddenly landed on Qin Yong's abdomen.
Lingquan Dantian was forcefully pulled out bit by bit from Qin Yong's abdomen by Qin Yi.
During the whole process, Qin Yong was screaming heart-breakingly!
When Lingquan Dantian was completely captured by Qin Yi.
Qin Yong's body turned directly into ashes.
His energy, blood, and soul were all brought out by the hidden demon seeds in Lingquan Dantian.
In Qin Yi's hand, the aura was shining brightly and pure vitality was gushing out.
Lingquan Dantian, as the name suggests, the vitality in the Dantian is like a spring. Warriors who have this kind of Dantian will progress very quickly in their practice.
The next moment, Qin Yi pressed the spiritual spring dantian containing the demonic seed in his hand against his abdomen.
Lingquan Dantian returns!
The demonic seed in Dantian turned into a magical force and spread instantly!
"Boom!"
Qin Yi's Lingquan Dantian seemed to make a loud noise like the beginning of the world.
Dantian is expanding rapidly.
Moreover, there was a little bit of golden light.
In just a few breaths, Qin Yi's Dantian was already like an ocean of Yuanli, and the Xuanhe golden light revealed a glorious and majestic meaning!
Qin Yi took back the spirit spring dantian and the demon seed, and transformed. The dantian was as vast as the sea, and golden light surged wildly.
